motivation.tampa_site_identity_audit: Formal older-history support disappears after adding stable node identity, implying strong persistent site heterogeneity.
motivation.eog_tampa_failure: Frozen EOG Layer-B became a static node-specific spatial/topology signature reused across repeated visits and was predictively adverse.
motivation.ecological_question: If fixed spatial identity is not the useful changing signal, does previous-year state of the surrounding meadow add information about next-year local quantitative state?

spatial_scales_km.source: Frozen Tampa EOG endpoint-3 Haversine world thresholds; reused without outcome-based tuning.
spatial_scales_km.sensitivity_role: Other three radii are descriptive robustness checks and cannot replace the primary radius.

segment_model: leave-one-node-out previous-year mean state within water_body
local_model: previous-year neighborhood mean minus previous-year water_body mean at the frozen radius

interpretation_map.segment_supported_local_not_supported: Shared bay-segment condition is an ecological context candidate; no evidence that finer local neighborhood adds beyond it.
interpretation_map.local_supported: Local spatial coupling/synchrony is a candidate above segment-wide condition; this does not establish dispersal or contagion.
interpretation_map.neither_supported: Next-year quantitative state is dominated by own recent state and persistent site identity at these scales.
interpretation_map.both_supported: Nested segment-wide and local spatial context both carry predictive information; mechanism remains unresolved.

claim_boundary: This is post-hoc exploratory ecology motivated by already-consumed Tampa and EOG results.
Predictive increment does not identify causal dispersal, contagion, competition, or environmental forcing.
A segment effect may represent shared environment, monitoring context, or other synchronized forcing.
A local-neighborhood effect may represent spatially structured shared forcing rather than biological interaction.
Do not tune radii, support rules, learner, or target years after opening this endpoint result.
